attackers_goals: Exfiltrate sensitive data from the cloud environment.
description: An EBS snapshot block was downloaded using the EBS direct API. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to exfiltrate data from a volume snapshot in the cloud environment.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Exfiltration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check the accessed snapshot and corresponding volume. Monitor additional snapshot blocks downloads from the snapshot. Verify that the identity did not download any sensitive information that it shouldn't.
name: An EBS snapshot block was downloaded

variations.name: An EBS snapshot block was downloaded from a snapshot with sensitive data
variations.description: An EBS snapshot block was downloaded using the EBS direct API. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to exfiltrate data from a volume snapshot in the cloud environment. The snapshot contains sensitive data.
variations.attackers_goals: Exfiltrate sensitive data from the cloud environment.
variations.investigative_actions: Check the accessed snapshot and corresponding volume. Monitor additional snapshot blocks downloads from the snapshot. Verify that the identity did not download any sensitive information that it shouldn't.

variations.name: An unusual download of EBS snapshot block
variations.description: An EBS snapshot block was downloaded using the EBS direct API. This may indicate an attacker's attempt to exfiltrate data from a volume snapshot in the cloud environment. The operation was not performed by this identity in the last 30 days.
variations.attackers_goals: Exfiltrate sensitive data from the cloud environment.
variations.investigative_actions: Check the accessed snapshot and corresponding volume. Monitor additional snapshot blocks downloads from the snapshot. Verify that the identity did not download any sensitive information that it shouldn't.
